title: Dingdong, Marian unveil official movie poster for 'Remember'
summary: Powerhouse couple Marian Rivera and Dingdong Dantes officially unveiled the poster for their upcoming movie “Remember,” which is set to hit cinemas nationwide on November 11, 2026.
